ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var res = JSON.parse(java.hexDecodeToString(result));
res.token = getJjToken();
let device = deviceType() ? 'ios' : 'android';
let typeMap;

if (device == 'android') {
    typeMap = { audio: 32, comic: 64 };
    book.type = res.tab in typeMap ? typeMap[res.tab] : 8;
} else {
    typeMap = { audio: 1, comic: 2, video: 3 };
    book.type = res.tab in typeMap ? typeMap[res.tab] : 0;
}
var headers = buildHeaders.call(this);
headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
var op = { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(res), headers: headers };
var request = getHost.call(this) + '/api/catalog,' + JSON.stringify(op);
result = java.ajax(request);
result = decryptIfEncrypted.call(this, result);
result = checkMsg.call(this, result);
result;
</js>

        chapter_index: result.chapter_index,
        source: result.source
    };
    let yunurl = java.base64Encode(JSON.stringify(content));
    result = `data:contentUrl;base64,${yunurl},{"type":"tingxue"}`;
}
</js>

searchUrl:
<js>
var conf = ensureConfig.call(this);
var sourceVal = conf.source || '';
var param = sourceVal ? '&source=' + sourceVal.split(',').map(function(s){ return s.trim(); }).join(',') : '';

var mode = conf.mode || 'novel';
var modeMap = {
    '📖小说': 'novel',
    '🎧听书': 'audio',
    '🌈漫画': 'comic',
    '▶️短剧': 'video',
    '⬇️下载': 'download'
};
if (modeMap[mode]) mode = modeMap[mode];

var sources = conf.sources || {};
var allTabs = Array.isArray(conf.allTabs) ? conf.allTabs : [];
var tabs = ['novel', 'audio', 'comic', 'video', 'download'];

var curList = sources[mode] || [];
if (curList.length == 0 && allTabs.indexOf(mode) == -1) {
    for (var i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) {
        var t = tabs[i];
        if ((sources[t] || []).length > 0 || allTabs.indexOf(t) != -1) {
            mode = t;
            break;
        }
    }
}

result = getHost.call(this) + '/api/search?keyword={{key}}&page={{page}}&tab=' + mode + param;
</js>
